title: [Supporting the Platform - PWABuilder - Homepage]: 'Get Started' button, 'PWA Starter' & 'Our privacy statement' links and all other controls present after 'Start' button are not visible and accessible at 200% resize mode.
body:
**User Experience:**
If any application does not support resizing of text (Except for captions and images of text) up to 200 percent without loss of content or functionality, the users with mild visual disabilities who scale the text instead of using the assistive technology would be impacted as zooming will not work as desired.

**Test Environment:**
OS: Windows 10 build 19608.1006
Browser: Edge - Anaheim - Version 85.0.545.0 (Official build) dev (64-bit)
URL: https://preview.pwabuilder.com/

**Pre-Requisite:**
Resize the browser to 200%

**Repro Steps**
1. Open the URL https://preview.pwabuilder.com/ in Edge Anaheim dev browser.
2. Pwabuilder home page will open.
3. Navigate to all the controls present on the screen.
4. Observe the issue.

**Actual Result**
'Get Started' button, 'PWA Starter' & 'Our privacy statement' links and all other controls present after 'Start' button are not visible and accessible at 200% resize mode.

**Expected Result**
'Get Started' button, 'PWA Starter' & 'Our privacy statement' links and all other controls present after 'Start' button should be visible and accessible at 200% resize mode.

**Note:**
Issue is repro at 400% mode also.
This issue is also repro for below URL's:
1.https://preview.pwabuilder.com/?url                      
2.https://preview.pwabuilder.com/ ?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.msn.com%2Fen-in%2F                             3.https://preview.pwabuilder.com/feature/Install%20your%20PWA.   4.https://preview.pwabuilder.com/feature/Web%20MIDI   5.https://preview.pwabuilder.com/feature/People%20Picker%20Graph%20Component  6.https://preview.pwabuilder.com/feature/Immersive%20Reader
